import numpy as np, torch, model, inspect
print(inspect.signature(model.load))
net=model.load(); neg=model.negatives()
try:
    n0=model.load('v0'); print('loaded v0')
except Exception as e: print('err',e); n0=None
torch.manual_seed(1)
def dec(n,xi,c): 
    a=model.decode(n,xi,torch.full((len(xi),),c)); return np.asarray(a[0] if isinstance(a,tuple) else a)
for c in [0.05,0.2,0.38,0.42,0.46,0.6,0.8,0.95]:
    xi=torch.randn(1024,2)
    a1=dec(net,xi,c); 
    ang1=np.arctan2(a1[:,1],a1[:,0]); h1=np.histogram(ang1,bins=16,range=(-np.pi,np.pi))[0]/1024
    s=f"c={c} r11={np.mean(model.in_basin(11,a1)):.3f} r14={np.mean(model.in_basin(14,a1)):.3f}"
    if n0 is not None:
        a0=dec(n0,xi,c); h0=np.histogram(np.arctan2(a0[:,1],a0[:,0]),bins=16,range=(-np.pi,np.pi))[0]/1024
        s+=f" r11_0={np.mean(model.in_basin(11,a0)):.3f} r14_0={np.mean(model.in_basin(14,a0)):.3f} TV={0.5*np.abs(h1-h0).sum():.3f} moved={np.mean(np.linalg.norm(a1-a0,axis=1)>0.3):.3f}"
    print(s)
